rules.gate: E288's, unchanged: an item's shares are reported only if its correct-count gain on D exceeds N of its task and scale (at least 1 when N = 0) and its log-odds gain G exceeds both L and 1; N and L from E288's results/stage0.json .gates
rules.compared: E288's, unchanged: the whole-circuit CMAP log-odds share on D, (mean log-odds patched - W0's) / (mean log-odds fine-tune - W0's), not clipped; compared within a format only; the A+B share beside it for every item
rules.beside: E288's, unchanged: per group (A, B, C, A+B, whole, 10 matched random sets) patched accuracy on D and its share; faithfulness F(Cir)/F(M) on D with each random set's overlap; pool sizes under m < -2 se and m < 0; p(clean label | noise prompt) under the fine-tune and W0
rules.no_call: E288's, unchanged: a share whose gain is 0 is null; an item that does not clear its gate reports its numbers with compared shares null
rules.large_pool: E288's, unchanged: an item with a pool over max_pool (16) waits for pricing and is run with --large-pools
rules.overrun: E288's, unchanged (Amendment 2): stage 1 stops when its first 4 items take more than rerun_over (2.5) times their estimate

expected.siblings: for reference only, E288's compared whole-circuit shares at s0 / s1: e46/ident32 0.559 / 0.548, e46/rand32 0.226 / 0.071, e53/cipher 0.028 / 0, e53/lowercase 0 / 0, e54/cipher_own 0.123 / 0.094; every sibling cleared its gate (results/items/*.json .compared)
